meta.name: English
app.name: ReticleX
common.name: Name
home.welcomeTitle: Design a crosshair you actually want to aim with.
home.welcomeBody: Tune every line, gap and outline in real time, save as many reticles as you like, and switch between them in a click.
home.recentSubtitle: Pick up where you left off
home.recentEmptyBody: Create your first reticle and it will show up here.
designer.tipLinkAxes: Keeps both axes identical so one slider moves them together.
tip.scale: Scales the whole reticle at once. Everything else stays in proportion.
tip.rotation: Turns the reticle around its center. Useful for X-shaped designs.
tip.opacity: How solid the crosshair looks. Lower values let more of the scene through.
tip.color: The main color of the crosshair lines.
tip.hLength: How far the left and right arms extend outward.
tip.hThickness: How thick the left and right arms are.
tip.hGap: Empty space between the center and where the left and right arms begin. A larger gap leaves your target clearer.
tip.vLength: How far the top and bottom arms extend outward.
tip.vThickness: How thick the top and bottom arms are.
tip.vGap: Empty space between the center and where the top and bottom arms begin.
tip.hEnabled: Turns the left and right arms on or off.
tip.vEnabled: Turns the top and bottom arms on or off.
tip.arms: Show or hide each arm individually.
tip.tShape: Hides the top arm so the reticle forms a T, keeping the area above your aim clear.
tip.capStyle: Flat ends are sharpest, round ends are softer, tapered ends narrow towards the tip.
tip.outlineEnabled: Draws a border behind the crosshair so it stays readable on bright scenes.
tip.outlineThickness: How far the outline extends past the crosshair.
tip.outlineColor: Outline color. Near-black reads best against most backgrounds.
tip.dotEnabled: Adds a dot at the exact center of the reticle.
tip.dotSize: The width of the center dot.
tip.dotOpacity: How solid the center dot looks.
tip.dotInherit: Keeps the dot the same color as the lines.
tip.dotShape: Square dots feel sharper, round dots feel softer.
tip.dotColor: A separate color for the center dot.
tip.dynamicEnabled: Simulates a crosshair that opens up while you move or fire.
tip.dynamicSpread: Preview how far open the crosshair currently is.
tip.dynamicGapBoost: How much extra gap is added when the crosshair is fully open.
preview.title: Preview
presets.title: Presets
presets.subtitle: Curated reticles plus everything you have saved
presets.emptyBody: Try a different search, or save the crosshair you are working on as a preset.
presets.builtInReadOnly: Built-in presets cannot be edited. Duplicate it to make your own version.
randomizer.title: Randomizer
randomizer.subtitle: Generate a design worth keeping, not just a random one
randomizer.lockBody: Unchecked properties are kept exactly as they are.
randomizer.seedTip: The same seed and settings always produce the same crosshair.
randomizer.empty: Press generate to roll your first crosshair.
settings.title: Settings
settings.themeTip: Dark is designed for long sessions; Midnight is darker still.
settings.accentTip: Used for highlights, focus rings and the active page marker.
settings.animationsTip: Turn off to remove transitions and motion across the app.
settings.uiScaleTip: Scales every element of the interface. Useful on very large or very small displays.
settings.languageTip: Applies immediately. Your choice is remembered between launches.
settings.startWithWindowsTip: Launches ReticleX when you sign in. No administrator rights required.
settings.autoSaveTip: Saves the crosshair you are editing a moment after you stop changing it.
settings.resetSettingsTip: Restores every setting to its default. Your saved crosshairs are kept.
settings.clearDataTip: Permanently deletes every saved crosshair and custom preset.
settings.creditsBody: Built with a C and C++ rendering core, a C# Windows host and a web front end.
dialog.descriptionPlaceholder: What is this reticle good for?
dialog.resetSettingsBody: Every preference returns to its default. Saved crosshairs and presets are not affected.
dialog.clearDataBody: Every saved crosshair and every custom preset will be permanently deleted.
dialog.discardBody: The current crosshair has changes that have not been saved.
toast.startWithWindowsOff: ReticleX will no longer start with Windows
import.errorJson: That file is not valid JSON
import.errorShape: That file is not a ReticleX crosshair
import.errorVersion: This file needs a newer version of ReticleX
import.errorTooLarge: That file is too large to import
import.errorTooMany: That file contains too many crosshairs
import.errorRead: The file could not be read
import.warnClamped: Some values were out of range and have been adjusted
import.warnInvalidColor: A color could not be read and was replaced
error.title: Something went wrong
error.hostUnavailable: Running without the desktop host. Changes are kept in this browser only.
error.saveFailed: The crosshair could not be saved
error.loadFailed: Saved data could not be loaded
error.coreFailed: The rendering core failed to load
error.coreFailedBody: ReticleX cannot draw crosshairs without it. Try reinstalling the application.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
preset.classic-cross.name: Classic Cross
preset.classic-cross.description: The four-arm reticle most players start from. Balanced gap, crisp outline.
preset.precision-dot.name: Precision Dot
preset.precision-dot.description: A single small dot for players who want nothing between them and the target.
preset.tight-mint.name: Tight Mint
preset.tight-mint.description: Short arms, tiny gap and a thin outline. Built for tapping heads at range.
preset.wide-hunter.name: Wide Hunter
preset.wide-hunter.description: Long arms and a generous gap that keeps the center of the screen readable.
preset.t-tactical.name: T Tactical
preset.t-tactical.description: No top arm, so nothing sits above your point of aim.
preset.neon-ring.name: Neon Ring
preset.neon-ring.description: Rounded caps and a soft glow colour for a modern, readable look.
preset.heavy-duty.name: Heavy Duty
preset.heavy-duty.description: Thick lines and a strong outline that survive the brightest scenes.
preset.dynamic-spread.name: Dynamic Spread
preset.dynamic-spread.description: Opens up as you move. Drag the movement slider to see the full spread.
